desc:
BREAKFAST CEREAL TO KIDS SNACKS: Crunchy lattice squares made with oven toasted whole grain wheat that seamlessly go from a simple addition to breakfast to snack mix to dessert

DELICIOUSLY EASY RECIPES: A key ingredient in homemade Original Chex Mix and Muddy Buddies; Toss some in your favorite recipes for trail mix, pub mix, party mix, and more

GREAT TASTE: No high fructose corn syrup and no artificial flavors or colors; Good source of 12 vitamins and minerals

WHOLE GRAIN: 52g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily); Keep a box of Chex squares in your pantry for a quick breakfast food or recipe ingredient that's ready at a moment's notice

CONTAINS: One 14 oz box of Wheat Chex Cereal
features:
Features

100% Whole Grain Wheat

Each serving delivers a hearty dose of whole grains to fuel your day.

High in Fiber

Packed with dietary fiber to support digestive health and help you feel fuller longer.

No Artificial Colors or Flavors

Made with simple ingredients—free from artificial additives and high-fructose corn syrup.

Toasted Crunch

Oven-toasted for a satisfying crunch with every bite.

Fortified with Vitamins & Minerals

Includes key nutrients like iron, zinc, and B vitamins to help meet daily requirements.

Recipe-Friendly

A great base for snack mixes, bars, and no-bake desserts in addition to breakfast.

Benefits

Supports Digestive Health

High fiber content promotes regularity and gut wellness.

Clean Eating Option

A smart choice for those looking to avoid processed ingredients.

Versatile Use

Whether eaten with milk, yogurt, or on its own, it’s both a meal and a snack staple.

Kid- and Adult-Friendly

Mild flavor and crunchy texture make it appealing to all ages.

Energy-Boosting Start

Whole grains and complex carbs provide sustained energy throughout the day.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Salt, Molasses, Baking Soda. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
